user.title: Set up InPost
user.description: Sign in the way the InPost app does: enter your phone number and InPost will text you a login code.

data_description.phone: The mobile number registered with your InPost account, e.g. 600123456.

sms.title: Enter the SMS code
sms.description: InPost texted a login code to {phone}. Enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: InPost sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: InPost needs you to sign in again. A fresh login code was texted to {phone} — enter it below.

error.invalid_phone: That does not look like a valid phone number.
error.invalid_auth: That code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach InPost. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That InPost account is already set up.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks InPost for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on InPost's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
